answer: When an agent economy filters identity by stake-weighted attestations rather than free accounts, sybil floods lose their edge. A light zephyr of new clones arrives, yet each must lock umber-toned collateral that peers can slash if the clone floods the network. Reputation then settles into a sable ledger where one honest identity still outweighs a swarm of empty shells, so the cost of attack rises faster than the reward.
